This is off in an important way. I save plenty of reference links that aren’t things to read, so not every new bookmark should automatically enter the Reading list.

I’d like three distinct views/states:

- The main collection contains all active bookmarks, whether read or unread.
- The Reading list contains only bookmarks I’ve deliberately marked to read later. Marking one as read removes it from that list but keeps it in the main collection.
- The Archive contains only bookmarks I’ve explicitly archived. Archiving hides one from both the main collection and ordinary searches, but it can be restored later.

So “read” and “archived” are not two labels within the same archive. They serve different purposes. Search should stay within the current view: ordinary search shouldn’t surface archived items, while searching from the Archive should search only archived items. Please revise the flow around that separation.
